description: "The Wonderful Story of Ravalette" by Paschal Beverly Randolph is a novel written in the late 19th century. This work weaves together elements of fantasy, magic, and mysticism, centering around the character Beverly, a melancholic figure burdened by his past and a curse linked to Rosicrucian lore.
